tooling_defect_2026_10_16: Task Manager graph rewrites can SILENTLY RESET task statuses: after adding P2-T24/T25/T26 the graph showed P2-T14 done->in_progress, P2-T15 done->in_progress and P2-T23 blocked->not_started, even though the TM's report claimed all existing tasks were byte-identical. Recovery used: copy the task's archived result back from docs/build/results/_archive/waveNN_<id>.json into docs/build/results/<id>.json, then advance (consolidates it back to done). NOTE the cp sets a fresh mtime, which makes build_wave treat the task as 'already re-run since escalation X opened' and stop re-dispatching it.
worker_death_policy_2026_10_16: STANDING: a worker that dies with its WORK COMPLETE (edit applied, its tests green) but the handoff artifacts missing -> the orchestrator verifies the ACs itself (not on trust), writes docs/build/results/<id>.json + docs/build/logs/<id>.md with honest provenance, and notifies the user rather than blocking. A death MID-EDIT (file left broken) still stops and waits for an explicit decision. The orchestrator never edits source code. Recorded in the global memory file as a preference.
